reason: The story passes `assets_dir: '@civictheme/../assets'`. Upstream's icon.twig reads the SVG from that directory at render time with `source()`; the Astro port resolves symbols through the generated `icons.ts` map instead and has no `assetsDir` prop, so the arg falls into the rest spread and prints as an attribute. The port must not add an `assetsDir` prop: it would be meaningless.

The story's `url` arg already contains the HTML entity `&`. Upstream's Twig renders with autoescape off, so the entity passes through verbatim and the parsed attribute value is `&`. Astro escapes attribute values correctly, so `&` becomes `&amp;` and parses back to `&`. Escaping is the correct behaviour; the pre-encoded story arg is the artefact.
portingRow: PORTING.md > (convention) > upstream jest harness sets `options.autoescape = false`

reason: tabs.twig:56 adds `data-tabs-tab` to every link with `link_attributes.setAttribute('data-tabs-tab', '')`.
